name: typing-defense
description: Lời Gọi (Wordwoven): a typing-assisted village defense.

scripts.check: node src/kit/verify-kit.mjs && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.deploy:pack: pnpm build && node scripts/deploy/prune.mjs dist && node src/kit/tools/deploy/check-pack.mjs dist --game typing-defense
scripts.deploy:pack:local: pnpm build && node scripts/deploy/prune.mjs dist && node src/kit/tools/deploy/check-pack.mjs dist --game typing-defense --allow-local-host
scripts.td:golden:update: node --import tsx scripts/td/golden.ts && node --import tsx scripts/td/golden.ts --boss
scripts.td:golden:check: node --import tsx scripts/td/golden.ts --check && node --import tsx scripts/td/golden.ts --boss --check
